raw_segments.text: Queen Elizabeth, that thou hast wronged in the time or past, for I myself have many tears
to wash her after time, for time passed wronged by thee.
The children live whose fathers thou hast slaughtered ungoverned youth, to wail it in
The parents live whose children thou hast butchered, old barren plants, to wail it with
Swear not by time to come, for that thou hast misused air used, by times ill-used or past.
